Makoto Tsumura (Japanese: 津村まこと Tsumura Makoto) is a Japanese voice actress for . She was born on July 22, 1965 in , .

==Pokémon roles==
Tsumura began to provide voices for Pokémon in . Her most important role in is that of Johanna in .
